major_cooldowns.name: Tiger's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend down to low energy before it comes off cooldown, then press it to snapshot Rake and Rip and to open the window for Berserk and Convoke the Spirits.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it only with Tiger's Fury already active, then keep generating so the overflow combo points convert into extra finishers, and as Druid of the Claw work Swipe into the window for Claw Rampage procs.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 106951, seen in 5/5 parses; ids 26662 and 343216 share the name and are talent or passive nodes.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it exactly like Berserk inside Tiger's Fury, and spend the free in-combat Prowl on a stealth Rake for the snapshot.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; replaces Berserk 106951 when talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it with Tiger's Fury and Berserk up, all your dots already applied, and straight after a finisher so no combo points are wasted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 391528, seen in 5/5 parses; 323764 shares the name and was not observed as a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it at 2 or fewer combo points, or 4 or fewer inside Berserk, and line it up with Tiger's Fury so the bleed is snapshotted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 274837; 274838 is the matching enemy bleed aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Frantic Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with Tiger's Fury up on two or more targets, or at low combo points in single target, and delay Tiger's Fury up to 2 seconds when that lines the two up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Replaces Feral Frenzy when talented; 1243807 is the castable id per its tooltip and was not pressed in the sampled parses, 1244023 is the matching bleed.

rule.description: Open stealth Rake into Berserk, Rip and Convoke
rule.action: Rake from Prowl, build to 5 combo points at low energy, then send Berserk with Tiger's Fury before Rip and Convoke.

rule.description: Berserk only with Tiger's Fury up
rule.action: Press Tiger's Fury first so the whole Berserk window is buffed.

rule.description: Convoke the Spirits only with Tiger's Fury up
rule.action: Hold Convoke until Tiger's Fury is running and fire it right after a finisher.

rule.description: Ferocious Bite only at full combo points
rule.action: Keep generating until you are capped and let Rip take the finisher when it needs refreshing.

rule.description: Bite at full energy for the damage bonus
rule.action: Pool to 50 energy before biting so it spends the extra 25 energy for double damage.
Refresh Rip at 5 combo points as it enters pandemic, and reapply it under Tiger's Fury.
Reapply Rake as it enters pandemic, preferably with Tiger's Fury up for the snapshot.

rule.description: Refresh Rake in pandemic, not early
rule.action: Let Rake run into its pandemic window before refreshing, and only clip it early when Tiger's Fury or stealth upgrades the snapshot.
Dump your energy into Shred in the seconds before Tiger's Fury comes off cooldown.
Spend down to as little energy as you can as Chomp comes off cooldown.

rule.description: Bite on every Apex Predator's Craving proc
rule.action: Fire Ferocious Bite the moment the proc lights up, ahead of everything else.

rule.description: Primal Wrath instead of Rip on several targets
rule.action: Spend your finisher on Primal Wrath once extra targets are up and Rip is missing or in pandemic.

rule.description: Swipe as your builder on several targets
rule.action: Swap your builder from Shred to Swipe once extra targets are up, and use it on Clearcasting procs.
